when.quote: To PREVENT future recurring charges on a debit card, use the recurring block feature.

starts.note: customer: start only when the customer wants future recurring charges stopped on a debit card that stays in use. If there is also a past charge to dispute, file the dispute first.
starts.quote: If customer was charged after cancellation AND wants to prevent future charges:

info.about: Whether the customer wants ALL recurring payments on the card blocked, after hearing the block is not limited to one merchant
info.ask: This would block all recurring and subscription payments on this card, not just one merchant. Would you like me to set that up?

info.about: Which debit card the block applies to
info.ask: Which debit card should the block apply to? The last 4 digits help.

steps.do: If the customer was not verified earlier in this conversation, verify them first, as in filing_a_debit_card_transaction_dispute: lookup, 2 matching values, get_current_time, log_verification. Otherwise reuse the verified user.
Unlock get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823, then call it for the card's checking account to get its card_id and status.

args.account_id: the card's checking account from the verified user's records

steps.quote: Use get_debit_cards_by_account_id_7823 to look up all debit cards associated with a specific checking account.

steps.do: If the card is CLOSED or is being closed in this conversation, do not set a block. Tell the customer recurring payments on the old card stop with it, and they must move them to the new card or cancel them with the merchant.
steps.if: the card's status is CLOSED or its card action in this conversation is close_and_reissue
steps.quote: Any recurring payments linked to this card will need to be updated with new payment information

steps.do: Explain that the block stops ALL recurring payments on the card, not just one merchant. If the customer only wants one merchant stopped, advise cancelling directly with that merchant instead.
steps.quote: Explain that this will block ALL recurring payments on the card, not just one merchant

steps.do: Advise the customer to cancel directly with that merchant. Do not set the block.
steps.if: the customer only wants one merchant stopped
steps.quote: If customer only wants to block one merchant, advise them to cancel directly with that merchant

steps.do: After any dispute for past charges has been filed, unlock set_debit_card_recurring_block_7382 and call it with block_recurring true.
steps.if: the customer confirms they want all recurring payments blocked and the card stays open

steps.do: Tell the customer four things: the block takes effect within 24 hours; one-time purchases are not affected; it does not cancel subscriptions with merchants; it stays until they ask to remove it. Advise them to confirm the cancellation with the merchant in writing. If the call returned an error, explain that the block was not set.
steps.quote: Still advise customer to confirm cancellation directly with merchant in writing

rules.rule: File the dispute for past charges first, then set the block
rules.quote: Then set up the recurring block for future protection

rules.rule: The block takes effect within 24 hours
The block does not cancel subscriptions
rules.quote: This does NOT cancel their subscriptions with merchants - they must still contact merchants directly

done_when: The block is set and the customer has been informed. Or the customer declined it, wanted only one merchant stopped, or the card is closed, and the customer was told what to do instead.
